description: This file contains selector functions for plugin-related UI components and state in a Mattermost web application, including functions to retrieve plugin settings, menu items, plugin components, and display logic based on license and app bar state.

methods.name: getPluginUserSettings
methods.description: Retrieves user settings for plugins from the global state.

methods.name: getFilesDropdownPluginMenuItems
methods.description: Retrieves menu items for the FilesDropdown plugin component.

methods.name: getUserGuideDropdownPluginMenuItems
methods.description: Retrieves menu items for the UserGuideDropdown plugin component.

methods.name: getChannelHeaderPluginComponents
methods.description: Gets plugin components for the channel header, filtering out those with overlapping app bar components.

methods.name: getChannelHeaderMenuPluginComponentsShouldRender
methods.description: Determines whether channel header menu components should render based on their shouldRender functions.

methods.name: getChannelHeaderMenuPluginComponents
methods.description: Filters channel header menu components based on their shouldRender conditions.

methods.name: getSidebarBrowseOrAddChannelMenuPluginComponents
methods.description: Retrieves sidebar browse/add channel menu plugin components.

methods.name: shouldShowAppBar
methods.description: Determines if the app bar should be shown based on enabled state and component presence.

methods.name: showNewChannelWithBoardPulsatingDot
methods.description: Checks whether to show a pulsating dot indicator for new channel with board tour.

methods.name: getSearchPluginSuggestions
methods.description: Retrieves search plugin suggestions if the license is valid.

methods.name: getSearchBoxHints
methods.description: Retrieves search box hints if the license is valid.

methods.name: getSearchButtons
methods.description: Retrieves search buttons if the license is valid.

methods.name: getPluginDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of a plugin given its ID, with fallbacks.
